g.text: ROGUE SHOOTER · TITLE MENU · #92 · A: CAMPFIRE LINEUP
Concept sheet, drawn in SVG by Claude (no image model). Not shipped. Reply Pick: A, B or C on the pull request.
WORDMARK AT 3X (drawn as pixel rects, never painted: R2, R24)
"ROGUE" at 3x; in game each letter pixel is 8 px on desktop
IN CONTEXT: PLAY → CLASS SELECT (existing screen)
Idea: the five heroes rest round a campfire under a hanging wood sign, monsters waiting at the edge of the dark; the menu reuses the class-select wood panels.
Risk: the busiest of the three; five heroes plus fire behind the menu may crowd small screens, and the sign needs care to stay legible over the glow.
